description: This is a unit test class for the JsonCollectors class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It contains tests verifying the correctness of JSON collection utilities, such as converting streams to JSON objects or arrays, and checking immutability assertions.

classes.name: JsonCollectorsTest
classes.description: A final class containing unit tests for the JsonCollectors utility methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the JsonCollectors class is immutable.

methods.name: collectingFieldsOfObjectReturnsEqualObject
methods.description: Tests that collecting fields of a JSON object into a new object produces an equal object.

methods.name: collectingFieldKeysOfObjectReturnsExpectedArray
methods.description: Tests that collecting field keys from a JSON object yields the expected array of key strings.

methods.name: collectingFieldValuesOfObjectReturnsExpectedArray
methods.description: Tests that collecting field values from a JSON object yields the expected array of values.

methods.name: collectingValuesOfArrayReturnsEqualArray
methods.description: Ensures that collecting values of a JSON array results in an array equal to the original.

methods.name: collectingObjectsReturnsExpectedObject
methods.description: Tests that combining multiple JSON objects into one results in the expected merged object.
